title: A boolean filter argument that uses CALCULATE is an error
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], 'Product'[Price] > CALCULATE ( AVERAGE ( 'Product'[Price] ) ) ) )

expected.error: CALCULATE has been used in a True/False expression that is used as a table filter expression. This is not allowed.

source.quote: It can't use a nested CALCULATE function.
source.supports: the rules for Boolean filter expressions

source.quote: It cannot reference a measure, and it cannot use CALCULATE.
source.supports: the limits of a True/False filter argument
